'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]]
**The death toll in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] from the [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s rises to 145 people, including 41 children. A second [[refugee camp]] is also bombed, after another was bombed yesterday resulting in multiple deaths. At least 950 people are wounded, while two protesters are killed in the [[West Bank]]. The [[headquarters]] of many media organizations in Gaza, including [[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]] and the [[Associated Press]], are destroyed by bombings. A man also dies in [[Ramat Gan]], in [[Tel Aviv District]], during a rocket attack; another person is also killed in another city, bringing the death toll there to 10. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/15/palestinian-death-toll-in-gaza-occupied-west-bank-mounts-live-news (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] says that airstrikes on Gaza will continue "as long as needed". He also warns [[Hamas]] leaders not to hide and that nobody is immune. [https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/israeli-assault-will-continue-long-needed-netanyahu-says (VOA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 6 people are killed, 3 are missing after a tourist boat capsized in [[Boyolali Regency]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://news.detik.com/berita-jawa-tengah/d-5570784/selfie-di-perahu-wisata-waduk-kedungombo-yang-berujung-maut?tag_from=news_mostpop (Detik)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****The [[General Administration of Sport of China]] announces that the summits of [[Mount Everest]] used by climbers in [[China]] will remain closed through the spring, citing COVID-19 concerns in both [[mainland China]] and neighboring [[Nepal]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/china-cancels-everest-spring-climbing-084232975.html (Reuters via Yahoo!)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kyrgyzstan]]
****[[Kyrgyzstan]] surpasses 100,000 cases of [[COVID-19]]. [http://en.kabar.kg/news/kyrgyzstans-covid-19-cases-exceed-100-000-mark/ (Kabar)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 44 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, including one foreign citizen. This subsequently brings the nationwide [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death toll]] to 1,866. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/05/15/health-ministry-malaysias-daily-covid-19-cases-remain-above-4000-with-most/1974318 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****The [[Taiwan]]ese [[Government of the Republic of China|government]] raises the alert level for [[Taipei]] and [[New Taipei City]] to level 3 for the next two weeks, urging citizens to limit gatherings to five people indoors and 10 people outdoors, avoid non-essential travel, and continue wearing [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|masks]] outside homes. This comes after a record 180 new COVID-19 cases were reported in the past 24 hours. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/taiwan-coronavirus-surge-measures/2021/05/15/e3b1836e-b544-11eb-a980-a60af976ed44_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
****[[France]] reaches a milestone of administering 20 million first doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210515-france-s-covid-19-jab-rollout-on-track-to-hit-target-of-20-million-doses (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reopens [[Bar (establishment)|bars]], [[restaurant]]s, and other establishments for outdoor usage for the first time in seven months and relaxes its [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask requirement]] as the number of COVID-19 cases declines and the number of [[COVID-19 vaccination|vaccinations]] increases. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/poland-rejoices-as-restaurants-reopen-mask-rules-are-relaxed (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] lifts its national [[state of emergency]] that has been in force since October as the number of COVID-19 cases declines, ending the curfew and all nationwide restrictions on gatherings. [https://spectator.sme.sk/c/22660005/national-emergency-ends.html (''The Slovak Spectator'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Trinidad and Tobago]]
***[[Prime Minister of Trinidad and Tobago|Prime Minister]] [[Keith Rowley]] declares a [[state of emergency]] in [[Trinidad and Tobago]] from midnight and imposes a curfew from 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. due to a surging number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-05-15/trinidad-and-tobago-declares-state-of-emergency-as-covid-19-cases-surge (U.S. News and World Report)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]]
***[[Venezuela]] approves the use of the single-dose [[Sputnik Light]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://apa.az/public/index.php/en/xeber/europe/venezuela-approves-russias-single-shot-covid-19-vaccine-349273 (Azeri Press Agency)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Austria]], [[Foreign relations of Iran]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Mohammad Javad Zarif]] cancels a trip to [[Austria]] after [[Chancellor of Austria|Austrian Chancellor]] [[Sebastian Kurz]] orders the [[Flag of Israel|Israeli flag]] to be raised at the [[Chancellery (Austria)|Chancellery]] and [[Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs|Foreign Affairs]] buildings yesterday. [https://www.politico.eu/article/iran-austria-palestine-israel-flag-vienna-foreign-minister-cancel-visit-javad-zarif-alexander-schallenberg/ (Politico.eu)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[International protests over the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis|Protests over the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]]
**The [[Jammu and Kashmir Police]] arrest 21 people in [[Kashmir]], [[India]], for organizing protests in support of [[Palestinians|Palestine]]. [https://theprint.in/india/jk-police-arrest-21-for-pro-palestine-demonstrations-warn-against-attempts-to-incite-violence/659027/ (''ThePrint'')]
**Police in [[Paris]], [[France]], use [[tear gas]] and [[water cannon]]s against pro-Palestinian protesters. This comes a day after a French court banned protests in support of Palestine. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/french-police-use-tear-gas-against-pro-palest-1250895.html (UrduPoint)]
**Protesters gather in [[London]] and [[Madrid]] in solidarity with Palestine. In [[London]], protesters gather at [[Hyde Park, London|Hyde Park]] and the [[Embassy of Israel, London|Israeli embassy]]. Former [[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|Labour Leader]] [[Jeremy Corbyn]] also speaks at the London protest. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210515-thousands-in-pro-palestinian-protests-in-london-madrid (France 24)] [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1859181/world (''Arab News'')] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/london-protests-israel-palestine-b1848112.html (''The Independent'')]
**In the [[United States]], protests are held in [[Atlanta]], [[Boston]], [[Louisville, Kentucky|Louisville]], [[Los Angeles]], [[New York City]], [[Philadelphia]], and other cities to demand an end to Israeli airstrikes in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/protesters-major-us-cities-decry-airstrikes-gaza-77716912 (ABC News)] [https://www.courier-journal.com/story/news/local/2021/05/15/louisville-residents-protest-violence-israel-support-palestine/5112248001/ (''The Courier-Journal'')]
**In [[Toronto]], several pro-Israel protesters are injured in clashes with pro-Palestine protesters at the [[Nathan Phillips Square]]. [https://www.jpost.com/diaspora/antisemitism/jews-assaulted-during-a-pro-israel-protest-in-toronto-watch-668300 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Ethiopian general election]]
**The [[National Electoral Board of Ethiopia]] delays the national elections, already postponed from August 2020, from June 5 to an unknown date, citing logistic issues. Prior to this, several oppositional parties were planning to boycott the election over the [[Tigray War]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/15/ethiopia-again-delays-national-election-amid-deadly-tensions (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**[[China National Space Administration]] [[Mars rover|rover]] [[Tianwen-1#Zhurong rover 2|''Zhurong'']] successfully lands at [[Utopia Planitia]] on [[Mars]], making [[China]] the third nation on Earth to achieve a [[Soft landing (aeronautics)|soft landing]] on the planet. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-57122914 (BBC News)]
*The Spectrometer for Heavy Atoms and Nuclear Structure, at the Heavy Ion Research Facility, in [[Lanzhou]], [[China]], is reported to have created a new [[Isotopes of uranium|uranium isotope]], [[uranium-214]]. [http://www.sci-news.com/physics/uranium-214-09658.html (Sci-News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020–21 Bundesliga]]
**[[Bayern Munich]] striker [[Robert Lewandowski]] scores his 40th goal of the season to equal the [[Bundesliga]] [[Bundesliga records and statistics|record]] set by [[Gerd Müller]] during the [[1971–72 Bundesliga|1971–72 season]] of the highest number of goals scored by a player in a season. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210515-robert-lewandowski-equals-bundesliga-record-with-40th-goal-this-season (France 24)]
*[[2021 FA Cup Final]]
**[[Leicester City F.C.|Leicester City]] beats [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] 1–0 at [[Wembley Stadium]] to win the [[2020–21 FA Cup]] with [[Youri Tielemans]] scoring the winning goal. It is Leicester City's first ever [[FA Cup]] title. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/57055571 (BBC Sport)]
*Five-time [[List of NBA champions|NBA champion]] [[Kobe Bryant]], 10-time [[WNBA All-Star Game|WNBA All-Star]] and four-time [[Basketball at the Summer Olympics|Olympic gold medalist]] [[Tamika Catchings]], three-time [[NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award|NBA Finals MVP]] [[Tim Duncan]], and 15-time [[NBA All-Star Game|NBA All-Star]] [[Kevin Garnett]] are inducted to the [[Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame]]. Bryant is inducted posthumously following [[2020 Calabasas helicopter crash|his death in January 2020]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/2021/05/16/basketball/nba/hall-of-fame-kobe-bryant/ (''The Japan Times'')]
